Overview

Slyderz is a modern food truck discovery and online ordering platform built to support local street food culture. It allows customers to easily find nearby food trucks, browse menus, and order ahead while giving food truck owners powerful tools to manage orders, update locations in real time, manage their social media, and grow their business. Built with performance and scalability in mind, Slyderz delivers a fast, reliable experience for both customers and vendors.

Key Features

  • Real-time food truck location tracking
  • Online ordering with Stripe
  • Admin dashboard with analytics
  • Live menu and availability updates
  • Order tracking and notifications
  • Customer account management
